stories.title: İstanbul’da bugün bazı yollar trafiğe kapatılacak: Saat 06.00’da başlıyor

en.title: Some roads in Istanbul will be closed to traffic today: Starting at 06:00
en.summary: Traffic restrictions will be implemented in Istanbul's Historic Peninsula and surrounding areas today due to the "I Run Istanbul" event beginning at 6:00 AM.

stories.title: Beylikdüzü Devlet Hastanesi’nde yemek boykotu: 30’dan fazla çalışan rahatsızlandı

en.title: Food boycott at Beylikdüzü State Hospital: More than 30 employees fell ill
en.summary: Over 30 workers at Beylikdüzü State Hospital became ill after meals served on September 28-30. Four unions plan a full cafeteria boycott on October 5, demanding independent inspection of food safety and hygiene conditions.

stories.title: MHK Başkanı Ferhat Gündoğdu istifa etti

en.title: MHK President Ferhat Gündoğdu resigned
en.summary: The President of the Central Referee Board was arrested on charges of illegally recording personal data as part of an investigation. He subsequently resigned from his position.

stories.title: Devlet hastanesinde 30'dan fazla kişi zehirlendi, çalışanlar isyan etti

en.title: More than 30 people poisoned at state hospital, employees rebelled
en.summary: Over 30 employees at Beylikdüzü State Hospital became ill following meals. Four unions have organized a response to address the food safety incident.

stories.title: Zen Pırlanta sahiplerini tehdit etmişlerdi! 'Çirkinler' böyle gözaltına alındı

en.title: Zen Diamond owners were threatened! 'The Uglies' crime gang arrested this way
en.summary: A criminal organization called 'The Uglies' in Istanbul allegedly threatened owners of Zen Diamond through messages sent from overseas numbers and were taken into custody.

stories.title: Adı fon skandalına karışan Fatma Betül Sayan Kaya tapu zengini çıktı: Milyonluk araziler, villalar, daireler…

en.title: Fatma Betül Sayan Kaya, linked to a fund scandal, turned out to be wealthy in real estate: Million-dollar lands, villas, apartments…
en.summary: Fatma Betül Sayan Kaya, who gained 2.17 billion Turkish lire from stock transactions and is central to a fund investigation, has been found to own significant real estate assets including land, villas, and apartments.

stories.title: 4 Ekim'de İstanbul'da hangi yollar trafiğe kapatılacak, alternatif güzergahlar neler?

en.title: Which roads will be closed to traffic in Istanbul on October 4, what are the alternative routes?
en.summary: Istanbul's police department announced which roads will be closed to traffic on October 4 due to a running event and provided information about alternative routes.

stories.title: Rusya’da veba paniği: 28 yaşındaki laboratuvar teknisyeni öldü, 189 kişi karantinada

en.title: Plague panic in Russia: 28-year-old laboratory technician died, 189 people in quarantine
en.summary: A 28-year-old laboratory technician in Russia died from plague, and authorities placed 189 people in quarantine while remaining unclear about the disease specifics.

stories.title: Zen Pırlanta'nın sahiplerine tehdit soruşturması…'Çirkinler'e operasyon: 5 kişiye tutuklama talebi

en.title: Investigation into threats against Zen Diamond owners... Operation against 'Uglies': 5 arrest requests
en.summary: Prosecutors conducted an operation against an armed criminal organization in connection with threats made to Zen Diamond owners. Five suspects were detained and referred to court with arrest requests after allegedly attempting extortion via foreign phone numbers.

stories.title: Fenerbahçe’nin hazırlık maçında ilginç anlar! Greenwood rakibine tekme attı, kırmızı kart gördü: 11’e 11 devam edildi

en.title: Unusual moments in Fenerbahçe's friendly match! Greenwood kicked opponent, saw red card: continued 11v11
en.summary: Mason Greenwood received a red card during Fenerbahçe's preparation match against Turan Tovuz for kicking an opponent off the ball. Unusual circumstances followed this decision.

stories.title: Greenwood kırmızı gördü: Fenerbahçe, 11 kişi devam etti

en.title: Greenwood saw red: Fenerbahçe continued with 11 players
en.summary: After Mason Greenwood's red card in Fenerbahçe's friendly against Turan Tovuz, both teams agreed to continue with equal numbers. A substitute replaced Greenwood so Fenerbahçe proceeded with 11 players.

stories.title: Muhtar, su kanalı çalışması sırasında toprak altında kalarak hayatını kaybetti

en.title: Mukhtar dies after being buried underground during water canal work
en.summary: A village mukhtar aged 50 died in Ankara's Polatlı district when a trench collapsed during water canal construction work.

stories.title: Irak, Hürmüz Boğazı’ndan 2 milyon varil petrol taşıdı

en.title: Iraq transported 2 million barrels of oil through the Strait of Hormuz
en.summary: Iraq's state oil tanker company transported 2 million barrels of crude oil through the Strait of Hormuz via a large oil tanker, marking the first such shipment in decades.

stories.title: Ferhat Gündoğdu MHK Başkanlığı görevinden istifa etti

en.title: Ferhat Gündoğdu resigned from his position as head of the Central Referee Board
en.summary: Five people, including Ferhat Gündoğdu, were detained and subsequently arrested in connection with an investigation into referees. Gündoğdu resigned as Central Referee Board chairman and another official resigned from his board membership.

stories.title: Pezeşkiyan: Ekonomik baskı arttı, hedeflerine ulaşmalarına izin vermedik

en.title: Pezeshkian: Economic pressure increased, we prevented them from reaching their goals
en.summary: Iran's president stated that economic pressure has intensified due to US maritime blockade and rising currency rates, but claimed his government's measures prevented adversaries from achieving their objectives in economic warfare.

stories.title: Altın Koza'da ödüller sahiplerini buldu: En İyi Film "Bir Arada Yalnız"

en.title: Golden Boll awards find their recipients: Best Film "Alone Together"
en.summary: At the International Adana Golden Boll Film Festival, the Best Film and Best Director awards in the national feature film competition went to Ali Vatansever's film "Alone Together".

en.title: England defeated Croatia 7-0
en.summary: England defeated Croatia 7-0 in a UEFA Nations League match played away, recording a historic victory.
